s1.syndrome_frame: progressive radicular pain and neuropathic symptoms in the lower extremity
salient_findings: radicular pain radiating from lower back down the left leg
mild hypesthesia in the left L5–S1 dermatome
solitary, completely cystic mass in the left L5–S1 foraminal zone
key_facts: 8-month history of radicular pain
pain radiates from lower back down the left leg
occasional tingling
no weakness, autonomic symptoms, history of trauma, or injury
mild hypesthesia in the left L5–S1 dermatome
normal muscle strength, normal abduction and adduction
negative Lasègue, Kernig, Bragard, and Sicard signs
electromyography showed neuropathic irritation of the left L4, L5, S1, and S2 roots
lumbosacral gadolinium-enhanced MRI revealed a solitary, completely cystic mass
mass measures approximately 13.9 cm in length and 1.9 cm in maximal diameter
mass is hypointense on T1-weighted images, hyperintense on T2-weighted images
mass demonstrates peripheral rim enhancement

shortlist.label: schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: cystic mass along the course of the sciatic nerve with peripheral rim enhancement

shortlist.label: neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: solitary, completely cystic mass in the left L5–S1 foraminal zone

shortlist.label: plexiform neurofibroma
shortlist.why_kept: longitudinal extent of the mass along the nerve

shortlist.label: ancient schwannoma
shortlist.why_kept: cystic degeneration and long history of symptoms

shortlist.label: perineurioma
shortlist.why_kept: hypointense on T1-weighted images, hyperintense on T2-weighted images

raw.rationale: The presence of a solitary, completely cystic mass along the course of the sciatic nerve with peripheral rim enhancement on MRI, and the absence of attachment to pelvic organs or other signs of neurofibromatosis, supports the diagnosis of schwannoma.

rejected.label: neurofibroma
rejected.why: While possible, the lack of multiple lesions or other signs of neurofibromatosis makes this less likely

rejected.label: plexiform neurofibroma
rejected.why: Typically associated with neurofibromatosis type 1 and presents with multiple lesions, not seen in this case

rejected.label: ancient schwannoma
rejected.why: The provided information does not specifically suggest degenerative changes typical of ancient schwannoma

rejected.label: perineurioma
rejected.why: This is a less common tumor and the imaging characteristics do not specifically point towards perineurioma
